Results.ReviewText: We've had a Weber gas grill for years. Just bought a new one after our old Weber Genesis gave out after over 30 years. Results.ReviewText: A review of my account with you will confirm that this is not the first Weber I've purchased... this experience required returning my purchase this summer to exchange for another that the lid wasn't cracked, then I discovered more problems while assembling the replacement.  After 4 trips to Home Depot (purchase site) and 2 calls to Weber customer service, I just today received the last replacement part (weeks after purchase).  Weber prices have gone up significantly since my previous purchase; customer service issues like I've experienced this time have to be part of the explanation.  Increased quality control during the manufacturing process would pay off in savings on the back end of the sale (my 1st grill this time was shipped to Home Depot with a cracked lid, and there were 2 other issues of defects).
Results.Title: Serious quality issues

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
